item.title: New Orleans homeowners property taxes due, lag in collections made
item.description: New Orleans property taxes are due Saturday, Feb. 28, and city leaders are urging people to pay them quickly, as about 70 percent of property owners have not yet paid their taxes.

item.title: JPSO investigates deadly Metairie car crash
